hints.title: Augmented State Space
hints.text: Track the node and the number of hops remaining as part of each state.

hints.title: Dual Neighbor Transitions
hints.text: For each adjacent edge, you have two transitions: traverse it normally or zero out its cost using one hop.

hints.title: Ordered State Expansion
hints.text: Expand states ordered by accumulated path distance until the target destination is reached.

hints.title: Expanded Dijkstra Algorithm

complexity.time: O(k * (E log V + V log V))
complexity.notes: Layered state space graph traversed via min-priority expansion.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Ignoring the remaining hop count violates the optimal substructure required for single-layer paths.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Distance matrix dist[u][hops] scales linearly with k.
